what: Named, hand-verified filings for the Roth / voluntary-after-tax flags. Pinned BY ACK, with the ROLE each one plays, so an instrument that stops reproducing its own motivating case fails loudly instead of printing a smaller number. A count that omits its own motivating case looks exactly like a count that includes it.

roles.denial: the published quote's own words DENY the flag it is published under — defect 1, docs/accuracy-log.md 2026-11-20
roles.subsequent-future: the flag is caused, or would be re-caused after a repair upstream, by an affirmative sentence inside a subsequent-events / plan-amendment section whose effective date falls AFTER the reported plan year — defect 2
roles.must-keep: a correct published yes, verified by reading the filing. A veto that withdraws this one is too wide and must not ship.
roles.must-stay-withdrawn: v207 WITHDREW this flag and the withdrawal was right. The ack is therefore CORRECTLY ABSENT from the published-yes population, and a tool that treats that absence as a missing pin is reporting its own bookkeeping as a defect — subsequent-events-size.mjs exited 1 on exactly that the first time it ran after the v207 merge. The claim is now the other way round and it is STRONGER than the one it replaces: if this ack ever publishes this arm again, a later change has undone v207 and the pin must FAIL. Nothing else in the repo guards the shipped fix against regression.

cases.verified: 2026-11-20, filing read: "After-tax contributions are not permitted by the Plan." and ZERO occurrences of Roth anywhere. The store holds afterTax: true and app.js:4080 renders it as "✓ Available". WITHDRAWN BY v207 (2026-11-21): the store now holds the flag FALSE with the denial quote retained as the evidence for the withdrawal, mirrored 13a445fb. The pin's role flips to must-stay-withdrawn: this arm reappearing means a later change undid v207.
cases.quote: After-tax contributions are not permitted by the 6 Plan.

cases.verified: 2026-11-20, filing read: the contributions note says "The Plan does not allow for Roth or after-tax contributions." while Note 8 — Subsequent events lists "Participants are allowed to make Roth contributions" under a restated adoption agreement effective January 1, 2026, after the plan year reported. Asked that section ALONE the shipped extractor returns roth=true, so the Roth flag is DOUBLY CAUSED and a negation veto alone would leave it wrong. WITHDRAWN BY v207 (2026-11-21): the store now holds the flag FALSE with the denial quote retained as the evidence for the withdrawal, mirrored 13a445fb. The pin's role flips to must-stay-withdrawn: this arm reappearing means a later change undid v207.
cases.quote: The Plan does not allow for Roth or after-tax contributions.

cases.verified: 2026-11-20, filing read at line 1038: "Except for highly compensated participants, participants are allowed to make contributions to the Plan in any combination of before-tax, after-tax and/or Roth contributions." Both arms are correct, and the sentence carries the words "allowed to make" — the exact token an over-wide negation veto keyed on allow/permit would destroy. It is the largest correct yes in the population.
